summary: The prompt over-splits inside quotative/reported-speech units, elliptical short predicates, and before clauses that introduce a needed subject or modifier antecedent, breaking pronoun and attachment resolution. Simultaneously, roughly half of long multi-clause sentences receive zero splits despite clear connective boundaries (-는데, -아서, -고+면), causing under-segmentation and lost latency gain. The system needs better recognition of clause-internal dependencies (quotes, pronouns, ellipsis) as no-split zones, paired with more aggressive splitting at independent-clause connectives.
